notes.title: v2 Update: New Maps, Navigation & Revamped Mission System
notes.notes:
Taxi Driver Simulator: Car Parking is now much bigger and much smoother with the v2 update! This huge update significantly increases both the content and gameplay quality of the game. Exploring the city, transporting passengers and showing your parking skills has never been more enjoyable.

v2 Update Notes

 3 New Scenes added: Now parking and passenger transport tasks await you in different city areas. Each scene will challenge you with its own atmosphere.
 Population System added: The city is more lively! There are now people on the streets and these details deepen the simulation experience.
 Navigation added to the map system: It is now much easier to reach mission points. You can progress without losing your direction with the navigation system.
 Graphics settings have been improved and optimized: Graphics quality has been increased, lighting and environmental details have been made clearer. Performance is more stable even on low systems.
 New languages ​​added: New language options have been added to the game. More players will now be able to play the game in their own language.
 Camera system improved: A more controlled and fluid camera experience is offered during driving and parking.
 Mission system redesigned: With the new mission logic, each mission is now more dynamic and rewarding. More clear and understandable goals are presented for players.
 UI adjustments have been made: The menu, mission screens and in-game interface have been redesigned. Everything is now much cleaner and more user-friendly.
